title: KOSBI: A Dataset for Mitigating Social Bias Risks Towards Safer Large Language Model Applications
findings: The paper's filter-based moderation approach effectively increased the ratio of safe sentence generations for the 'Religion' category. The performance and improvement for this category were comparable to other demographic categories analyzed, demonstrating the method's efficacy across different social groups.
